text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan, thanks for the present earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was surprised... How did you even 
know about such a stylish body mist?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I thought it'd be nice to get 
something special. So I worked up the 
courage to visit a specialty shop, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, Dober, wanna come along next 
time? There were a bunch of other things 
that caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know the bar's set high, but this 
is something we should practice 
together... right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, you know, as long as Dober's with 
me, I feel like I'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah. With you by my side, Ryan, I 
feel like I'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's settled! We're going 
shopping this weekend!
